- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested methods for removing old wax or varnish include solvent-based stripping, heat gun and scraping, and chemical stripping.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Recommended solvents include mineral spirits, turpentine, and lacquer thinner.

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided steps for heat gun and scraping, including applying heat and scraping off the softened finish.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Provided steps for chemical stripping, including applying the stripper, letting it sit, scraping off the old finish, and wiping clean.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include working in a well-ventilated area, testing a small area first, avoiding harsh chemicals, and using a wood conditioner after stripping.
